brief.prompt: A small white bathroom shelf holding just three plain unbranded skincare containers: a pump cleanser bottle, a round moisturizer jar and a slim sunscreen tube, next to a folded sage-green hand towel. Soft morning light, clean tiled wall behind, no text or labels on any product.
brief.alt: Minimal skincare shelf with cleanser, moisturizer and sunscreen
brief.purpose: Shows the short, three-product routine recommended in the skincare section, reinforcing that less is more.
